card.summary: no service and no account; a CLI that registers with Cloudflare and writes a profile

free_tier.stated: no service and no account; a CLI that registers with Cloudflare and writes a profile

egress.terms: not stated by this tool; the profile reaches Cloudflare WARP, whose allowance is recorded at egress/cloudflare-warp as no published cap; ingress: none

record.tooling: single static binary; outputs a wg-quick profile
record.chaining: generates the .conf that cloudflare-warp's record describes, and the profile can then be fed to a router, gluetun, or a kernel interface.
record.binding_note: the tool adds no limit; the limit that matters is whatever WARP applies, and its record carries none published

identity_cost.detail: no account and no card; "wgcf register" creates the Cloudflare device registration from the CLI

record.reliability_note: usque reports that WARP+ over WireGuard stopped working for some accounts (wgcf issue 459); the generated MTU of 1280 is conservative and can be raised
record.confidence_note: a probe that brings the generated profile up and moves bytes would raise it to measured

evidence.proved: the register / generate / license-key feature list and the wgcf-profile.conf output
"To ensure maximum compatibility, the generated profile will have a MTU of 1280" and --keepalive adds PersistentKeepalive
release v2.3.1 published 2026-10-11; last push 2026-10-20; 8826 stars
the Warp+ binding is capped: "there is a limit of 5 maximum devices linked at a time"

record.notes: Cross-platform CLI tool generating standard WireGuard configuration files for Cloudflare WARP. Output .conf files run on standard WireGuard clients, requiring outbound UDP access to Cloudflare endpoints.

extras.wg_detail: "wgcf register" saves wgcf-account.toml and "wgcf generate" writes wgcf-profile.conf, which is a standard WireGuard profile with MTU 1280
extras.volume_stated: not stated by this tool; the profile reaches Cloudflare WARP, whose allowance is recorded at egress/cloudflare-warp as no published cap
extras.transit_note: traffic exits through Cloudflare's network once the profile is up
extras.hosting_requirement: none; runs on the device and emits a .conf
